teleto.label: Tengu: 'The tengu commands you to return.'
teleto.explanation: The tengu's teleport-to moves the Borg from (10,12) to (12,12), next to the tengu. Original: Lunal mode stays on (lunal_mode after=1) and the stair decision starts walking to the down staircase although the Borg is not prepared for depth 11. Corrected: Lunal mode is switched off when the SPELL_068 reaction is handled, and the same decision refuses the descent.

SETUP seed=193 mode=teleto class=Warrior clevel=15 depth=10 caster=tengu(13,12) borg=(10,12) stairs_down=1 stairs_up=1 lunal_config=1
  lunal_mode_after_monster_spell  TRACK player-moved (10,12)->(12,12) caster-at (13,12)
TRACK game-message <The tengu commands you to return.>
TRACK borg-reaction <SPELL_068:The tengu>
STATE lunal_mode before=1 after=1 borg=(12,12)
STATE prepared_for_depth_11=restock phase door
DECISION heads_for_down_stairs=1 goal_type=6 first_key=51
OUTCOME lunal_after=1 heads_down=1
